Harmonized CreatorIndexDocument and MeilisearchDocument schemas, and added runtime primaryKey validation and bidirectional normalization in MeilisearchAdapter.
knownIssues.impact: none — verified with 11 adapter tests and 5 projection regression tests passing

knownIssues.title: GDPR erasure Meilisearch deletion synchronization gap (Step 2B.2)
knownIssues.description: Resolved: Implemented deleteDocument and deleteDocumentFromIndex on MeilisearchAdapter with canonical creatorId validation, absent document idempotency, circuit breaker, and retry discipline. Added deleteCreatorFromIndex and hardened projectCreatorToIndex to strictly block re-indexing erased creators (piiErasedAt, displayName, or primaryHandle = [ERASED]). Added creator-erasure background consumer in workers to sync creator.erased events with Meilisearch, preserving transactional outbox guarantees (retry on failure) and ensuring zero PII logging.
knownIssues.impact: none — verified with 21 adapter tests, 10 database tests, and 11 worker tests passing

knownIssues.title: Live creator discovery synthetic metrics fabrication, LLM provider contract mismatches, and synchronous scraping (Phase 3A)
knownIssues.description: Resolved: Completely eliminated enrichFallbackCandidate and synthetic metrics generation from DiscoveryOrchestrator, enforcing truthful null metrics, minimally complete profiles, and explicit failure reasons. Verified Groq model identifiers (llama-3.1-8b-instant, llama-3.3-70b-versatile) and implemented native Anthropic Messages API contract with x-api-key, anthropic-version, and top-level system parameter. Corrected PostgreSQL similarity function name to gcp.find_similar_creators. Designed and implemented asynchronous discovery architecture with wp.discovery_job table (V016 migration), transactional outbox event routing, credit reservation and commit/refund semantics, worker idempotency, HTTP 202 Accepted polling route, and frontend polling integration.
knownIssues.impact: none — verified with 48 adapter tests, 74 database tests, 404 API tests, 21 worker tests, and full monorepo typecheck pass

knownIssues.title: Brain 1 + Brain 2 Integration Verification & Recovery Hardening (Phase 3B)

Aligned frontend polling buffer to 240s with resumeDiscoveryJob support and truthful empty states when timeouts occur (eliminating silent mock fallbacks). Resolved credit repository idempotency bugs (isLedgerActionApplied, getBalance) and creator repository fallback handling. Created comprehensive end-to-end integration test (brain1-brain2-e2e.integration.test.ts) exercising request submission -> credit reservation -> atomic worker claim -> deterministic provider execution -> truthful DB persistence -> Meilisearch projection -> Brain 1 filtered search retrieval, cross-workspace isolation, and GDPR erasure immutability.

knownIssues.title: Phase 3I Real PostgreSQL RLS Audit and Worker Race Verification
knownIssues.description: Resolved critical worker race conditions and tenancy leakage risks: (1) Fixed reveal.routes.ts line 222 which previously bypassed request-scoped clientDb; (2) Wrapped all worker DB operations (claimJob, extendLease, completeJob, failJob) in withWorkspaceTransaction; (3) Hardened discoveryJobRepository with atomic attemptCount ownership checks to prevent stale workers from overwriting newer job states; (4) Added AbortController / AbortSignal cancellation propagation to DiscoveryOrchestrator so that when a 210s timeout or lease expiry occurs, ongoing external calls (Serper, Apify, LLM) are aborted and late responses cannot commit credits or emit completion events; (5) Diagnosed prepared statement compatibility with PgBouncer/Supavisor transaction pooler; (6) Verified monorepo with 586 tests passing, 0 typecheck errors, and clean lint. Audited live PostgreSQL RLS environment: local Docker is stopped and remote Supabase pooler returns 'tenant not found', correctly classifying live DB RLS verification as BLOCKED per AGENTS.md Reality Over Intent.
knownIssues.impact: Worker reliability and race defenses hardened in code; live deployment pending Supabase pooler activation and Meilisearch instance provisioning.

knownIssues.title: Phase 3J Independent Verification, Provider AbortSignal Wiring & Integration Infrastructure Hardening
knownIssues.description: Independently verified Phase 3I code and identified/resolved critical provider cancellation gaps: (1) SerperAdapter, ApifyAdapter, and LLMAdapter were updated to accept and honor AbortSignal across all HTTP fetch requests and retry loops, ensuring cancelled operations do not leak sockets or perform late queries; (2) DiscoveryOrchestrator now passes activeSignal directly into Serper, Apify, and LLM adapter calls and rethrows AbortError immediately; (3) Hardened integration testing infrastructure in packages/testing/src/integration.ts by supporting TEST_DATABASE_URL environment variable to allow running real PostgreSQL integration tests against any local or disposable PostgreSQL 16 database without requiring Docker; (4) Dynamically loaded all migrations from supabase/migrations (V001–V017) instead of a hardcoded array frozen at V009; (5) Added custom endpoint/LocalStack support in SQSPublisher and EventWorker bootstrap; (6) Documented FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY requirement for table owner connections. Verified all 589 tests across 50 suites passing with 0 typecheck and 0 lint errors.
knownIssues.impact: None — monorepo 100% sound and verified; live cloud pipeline remains blocked on external resource provisioning.

knownIssues.title: Phase 3K Real PostgreSQL RLS Verification, Table-by-Table Security Audit, and Integration Safety Guards
knownIssues.description: Executed comprehensive Phase 3K audit: (1) Identified that ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY allows table owners (e.g. test or postgres) to bypass RLS policies on all WP tables except wp.discovery_job unless FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY is enabled or queries run under unprivileged application roles; (2) Discovered that role 'mushin_system_worker' (declared in AGENTS.md invariant) and role 'mushin_app' (referenced in V016) were never created in V001; (3) Discovered wp.reveal policy in V013 lacks missing_ok=true in current_setting; (4) Hardened creditRepository.releaseCredits with double-checked locking under SELECT FOR UPDATE to prevent concurrent refund races; (5) Hardened packages/testing/src/integration.ts with validateDisposableDatabase safety guard and transaction-aware workspace execution; (6) Audited provider cancellation and stale-worker attemptCount protection. Monorepo verified with 590 unit/mocked tests passing (0 failures), clean typecheck, clean lint, and clean build. Live PostgreSQL RLS and live Brain 2 pipeline marked BLOCKED due to absence of disposable PostgreSQL 16 and Meilisearch instances.
knownIssues.impact: Production and live test safety guaranteed; full table-by-table RLS analysis and proposed V018 migration ready for approval.

knownIssues.title: Phase 3L V018 Security Review, Disposable Database Safety Hardening, and Real PostgreSQL RLS Verification
knownIssues.description: Executed Phase 3L review and hardening: (1) Performed statement-by-statement review of proposed V018: identified critical permission gaps in mushin_system_worker (must exclude UPDATE/DELETE on immutable append-only ledger/timeline) and mushin_app (requires INSERT on platform.outbox for transactional outbox pattern, must exclude UPDATE/DELETE on ledger/timeline); (2) Discovered missing DELETE policies on wp.list, wp.list_member, and wp.workspace_creator_link that would break deletion endpoints under FORCE RLS; (3) Identified workspace onboarding and initial credit balance creation conflicts under unprivileged roles; (4) Hardened validateDisposableDatabase to strictly block production/staging DATABASE_URL, cloud-managed hosts (supabase.co, neon.tech, aws.com), pooler port 6543, production keywords, and require strict naming ('mushin_test') plus multi-part remote safeguards (allowlist + confirmation token); (5) Hardened cleanupTestDatabase with in-session current_database() verification before truncation; (6) Authored comprehensive 8-scenario integration test suite in tenant-isolation.integration.test.ts covering cross-workspace isolation, missing/empty context denial, pooled connection hygiene, concurrent rollbacks, onboarding, contact reveal/discovery jobs, credit refund concurrency, and stale worker attempt guards; (7) Verified 600 tests passing across 51 test files, 16/16 typecheck tasks passing, 16/16 lint tasks passing, and Next.js 32/32 static production build passing. Live PostgreSQL RLS marked BLOCKED per Reality Over Intent due to offline local Docker engine and absence of isolated disposable PostgreSQL 16 instance.
knownIssues.impact: Test infrastructure verified 100% safe against accidental production truncation; revised V018 migration ready for operator approval.
